result:
Round 205 is planned and ready for A. The decision is **CONTINUE**.

**Round 204 outcome.** C passed every row in a real browser at 375, 1280 and 1440 widths. The publishing gate still blocked it: implementation doc 161 says a test exists (the user menu closes after sign-out), and no such test was ever written. The round-204 changes stay in the tree uncommitted; nothing was reverted. Its three bugs (C-R202-04, C-R202-05, B-R201-HEADER-USERMENU-KEYBOARD) are recorded as "C passed, gate blocked". They become done only when root publishes rounds 204 and 205 together.

**Round 205: three items, one class (focus or scroll position lost around an overlay)**
- **R108, the gate fix:** add the missing test HF6b and fix doc 161. Deleting the doc line instead would leave shipped behaviour untested. My scratch copy shows HF6b passes on the round-204 code and fails when the sign-out reset is removed.
- **R109, B-R203-LEADMAGNET-AUTO-OPEN-FOCUS (Medium):** the auto-opening "FREE DOWNLOAD" popup becomes a real dialog:
  - focus starts on ✕;
  - each step moves focus to its own control;
  - Escape closes it the same way ✕ does;
  - Tab cannot leave it;
  - focus returns to where it was;
  - the error text is announced.
  
  The popup's text, classes and steps stay as they are (Saba's keep-list).
- **R110, B-R204-SCROLLLOCK-POSITION-LOST (new Medium, found while planning):** `useScrollLock` reads the scroll position only after it has fixed the body, when the position is already 0. So closing the popup or Sign In sends the page back to the top. On the current code I measured 2037 → 0 and 1500 → 0; with the one-line reorder the position is kept.

On my scratch copy, these fixes pass every existing test that checks this code (48/48).

A gets 4 files to change and 2 new files; every other file is hash-locked. C checks 13 browser rows, including the Studio Export dialog, because the scroll-lock hook is shared. Purchase protection and the anonymous `/studio-lab` are re-checked. The full test suite is left to the gate.

**Records**
- **Backlog (version 190):** 8 new Lows deferred; the Safari check went on the Tech Lead list. The reviewer's architecture note (the user menu now lives in `Header.tsx`, and `UserDropdown.tsx` is unused) is logged as a signal and added as question 5 to the pending non-blocking checkpoint request. No new task was created from it.
- **Other files updated:** `feature-status.md`, `lessons.md` (new L26: docs cite only tests that exist; new L27: re-render with a fresh element in tests), `b-round-204.md`, `b-next.json`.
- `tasks/round-204.md` is an exact copy of the previous task. All backups are in `b-round-204/`. The store working tree is unchanged.
- I used the advisor twice. The second call added a check that doc 162 cites only real tests, the Studio Export dialog row, and a fix to one test row that jsdom could not prove.

**Next after round 205:** SYS-1, SYS-2, SYS-3, then STORE-2b. The regression round is due on or after 2026-10-30.
